# ship-settings

Your interface to the `settings` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`settings.state`](references/docs/settings.state.mdoc) — Harnesses, defaults, terminal, about — everything the settings view renders.

## Commands

- [`settings.set`](references/docs/settings.set.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Set a runtime setting (value is arbitrary JSON).
